title: Cipherframe job result
description: The document an external worker writes to external_tasks.result when it completes or fails a task (ADR 0010). Every derived artifact must be listed so the Go side can register it (invariant I6).

envelope_version.description: Version of the contract the result follows; it equals the envelope's version.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this result answers.

error.description: Required when status is failed. The message is for operators only and must never hold secrets, tokens, signed URLs or source object keys.

code.description: Stable lower_snake_case identifier of the failure.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the task may succeed. False sends the task to the dead-letter list.

artifacts.description: Derived artifacts the worker wrote to storage. The Go side registers each one.

key.description: Storage key of the derived artifact.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes.
